changes_from_live: Live has no data. Add fmt %N%n%O%n%A%n%C %Z, zip P\d{3}(?: ?\d{4})?, require ACZ.
final.notes: UPU sheet (05/2025): 8-char code 'P'+governorate+sector+zone (3 digits) + 4-digit delivery point, the latter 'if possible', written right of the locality ('JERUSALEM P126xxxx'). Introduced in the West Bank in Feb 2021. Gaza has a separate postal administration and it is unclear the codes are used there; areas under Israeli control use Israel Post 7-digit codes. Low confidence on whether Z should be required. Recommend required AC with Z optional if the product serves Gaza or East Jerusalem. UPU General-Addressing-Issues (Aug 2026) lists Palestine under countries that require postal codes, with types P9999999 and P999 (lengths 8 and 4). The 'if possible' wording applies only to the 4-digit delivery-point suffix, so Z stays required (the 3-digit P-prefix form is accepted). postcode.palestine.ps is only a map app (and has a self-signed cert), so it gives no format rules.

decisions.required: kept original (ACZ): pseEn.pdf (05/2025) applies 'if possible' only to the final point of delivery (xxxx). The P+3-digit part appears in every example ('JERUSALEM P126xxxx', 'JERUSALEM P144xxxx', 'RAMALLAH AND AL-BIREH P6100154'). UPU General-Addressing-Issues (Aug 2026) lists Palestine under 'require postal codes' with types P9999999/P999, and the pattern already makes the suffix optional. Gaza and Israel Post coverage is a product-scope question that no official source settles; it does not override the UPU listing.

dropped_tokens.PAK: UPU: the 6-digit PAK (street-level postal address code) goes on its own line ('PAK 456769') below the '24210 BAJMOK' line, and Pošta Srbije asks for it on home-delivery mail. With one postcode field we can hold only one of the two. Leaving PAK out still delivers (5-digit post-office code + street is enough) but is not compliant.

changes_from_live: zip \d{5,6} mixes the 5-digit post-office code and the 6-digit PAK in one field. A PAK printed as '%Z %C' ('456769 BAJMOK') is wrong. Recommend Z = 5-digit only, optionally a separate PAK field.
final.notes: UPU layout: street / LOCALITY / 'NNNNN POST OFFICE' / 'PAK NNNNNN'. Locality and delivery post office can differ (e.g. BEOGRAD (ZVEZDARA) vs 11130 KALUĐERICA). Decide whether to add a PAK field or accept 5-digit only. UPU srbEn (01/2025): 'the PAK shall be included in the address below the number and the name of the delivery post office'; it is not needed for P.O. Box, poste restante or military mail. A PAK line ('PAK %X' or a dedicated field) and a separate locality line need a schema decision; they cannot be added to this layout without repeating %C.

decisions.layout: kept original: the checker's proposed '%N%n%O%n%A%n%C%n%Z %C' + 'PAK %X' puts %C on two lines, so it prints the same value twice. That is wrong for the sheet's own 'BEOGRAD (ZVEZDARA)' / '11130 KALUĐERICA' example, as the checker itself notes. srbEn.pdf (01/2025) does require the PAK line for street mail. That gap is already recorded in dropped_tokens.PAK, but closing it needs a new field (PAK, and a locality separate from the delivery office), not this string.
